_comment: Invrisil 8c Task C1 (issue #12). Lifted from docs/design/dialogue-drafts/invrisil/fixer.json (dialogue-drafts lane, 2026-07-06) verbatim -- the street fixer 'Cups': rumor-by-the-cup vending (5 one-gold rumors seeding city texture + quest-path hints) + the TALK-path testimony chain. Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-06-invrisil-design.md sec.2/sec.4 ('sells rumors by the CUP -- tea-house pricing bit'). Voice contract: character-profiles-staging.md 'The street fixer' (sells rumors by the cup, trade cant, genuinely likes gossip beyond its price). Speaker 'Cups' = ORIGINAL street-name+flag. SAFE TO WIRE NOW (unlike Wilovan/Coyle's full quest graphs): every effect here is gold/accomplishment only -- no `quest`/`start_combat`/`remove_entity` effect, so nothing forward-references an entity or quests.json row Task C3 hasn't landed yet. The testimony chain (balk/agreed_persuaded/agreed_paid/arranged) requires `took_brothers_job`/`fixer_will_testify`, both absent==0 today -- naturally hidden until C3's quest banks them, a forward reference (same convention as C2's Wilovan combatant record). Rumor buys: gold-gated (grey visible when broke, D1/D2 precedent) + hide_when heard_rumor_* (each sells once). Softlock audit (from the draft, re-verified against this exact file): hub has many hidden/gold-locked options + an ungated 'Just the tea today.' exit; balk keeps an ungated 'Fair. Forget I asked.' back-out; no start_combat anywhere.

hub.speaker: Cups
hub.text: Tea comes free with the rumor; rumor's a gold the cup. Sit on the crate — mind the wobble, it's structural. Now. What are we drinking?

text_variants.text: Testimony's steeping — my face on paper, gods help my complexion. One cup left in the pot worth pouring: Hellam. Say when.
Hellam signed, I signed, and for once I'm IN the best rumor on the street instead of selling it. Tea's still a gold. Fame hasn't changed me.

options.text: The alley boys. What's their round? (1 gold)
Who in this city hates Coyle enough to say so? (1 gold)
The men in the hats. (1 gold)

options._comment: GH#68 (quest-stage rework): the trust-arc trigger -- 2 real purchases (bought_rumor_from_cups threshold) plus Stage 1 scouting (coyle_operation_found), hidden until met, then hidden again once the favor is offered (cups_favor_requested) so it never re-offers.
options.text: Two cups deep. What's the real price, Cups?
I need more than rumor. Coyle hired that theft — will you swear to it?
Pour for three. Set it up with Hellam.

rumor_footpads.speaker: Cups
rumor_footpads.text: Wister's Alley boys walk it in pairs, and pairs keep habits: every round they turn at the fish-drying racks — both heads, every time, like the fish might've moved. That's a whole alley of nobody-looking twice a bell. A patient someone could stroll it like a garden. Drink up.

rumor_counting_house.speaker: Cups
rumor_counting_house.text: Lamps burn past midnight there two nights before every 'audit' — a man cooking books likes them fresh. Better cup: the clerk with the inky cuffs takes his supper OUT, and props the yard-side door for his return. Props it with a cheese wedge. I have SEEN the cheese. That's not rumor, that's reportage.

rumor_hellam.speaker: Cups
rumor_hellam.text: Master Hellam — silk trade, salt tongue. Coyle soured their partnership over a warehouse lease, then bought that same lease through a cousin. Hellam keeps the grudge fed and walked like a prize hound. He'd testify against Coyle at his own wedding, mid-vow, and call it a toast.

rumor_hats.speaker: Cups
rumor_hats.text: The Brothers? Sweetest muggers you'll ever meet. Tip the hat, beg your pardon, relieve you of exactly what's owed and not a clip more — I've had ruder service in shops. But the whole street knows the arithmetic: hat on, you talk. Hat comes off, you RUN, and you don't spend breath asking why.

rumor_door.speaker: Cups
rumor_door.text: There's talk of a door — an inn door, in some Drake town two hundred miles south — that opens HERE, when it's minded to. Adventurers swear by it. Me, I say any door that shortchanges two hundred miles of road out of its gossip is a menace to my trade personally. ...Marvelous, though. If true.

balk._comment: GH#68 (quest-stage rework): the trust-arc gate. Base text (default, returned_cups_debt unmet) is the NEW diegetic hold -- Cups won't risk her face until the favor's settled; the text_variant restores the ORIGINAL 'different water' speech once the favor is done. Both real options below extend their requires with the same accomplishment leg (sanctioned compounds: {accomplishment, class} for the Diplomat branch, {gold, accomplishment} for the paid branch -- test_content.gd's own two pre-existing sanctioned shapes, just with returned_cups_debt standing in), so a player who rushes here still sees ONLY the ungated 'Fair. Forget I asked.' exit until the trust arc is actually walked.
balk.speaker: Cups
balk.text: Not for cups of tea, friend. You want my FACE on this, you've got to be worth the risk first — and 'worth it' isn't free, is it, given what a hat can turn into round here.

text_variants.text: Swearing's different water, friend. A rumor's a bird — nobody knows whose window it flew from. Testimony has my FACE on it, and Coyle prices faces. Some of them stop being worn.

options._comment: GH#64: skill-gated (was class-gated Diplomat) -- [Charming Smile] fits the social intent (turning a wary contact friendly) better than the bare class. The 10-gold branch below is the existing non-Diplomat alternate (already omits persuaded_someone). GH#68 adds the returned_cups_debt leg (sanctioned {accomplishment, skill} compound) -- hidden until the favor's done, same as the pay branch below.
options.text: Stand with the Brothers, and every hat tips your way. [Charming Smile]
Ten gold says the water's fine. (10 gold)

cups_favor._comment: GH#68 (quest-stage rework, TALK path Stage 2): the favor beat itself -- grants the carry item (#59 item-gate/remove_item seam), returned at invrisil_wilovan.json's hub. Single ungated option (the arranged/just_tea precedent) satisfies the softlock guard trivially.
cups_favor.speaker: Cups
cups_favor.text: Here's the third thing, then, since you keep buying the first two. I owe the Brothers a debt I've been quietly not paying — a chit, is all, but it's got Wilovan's own mark on it and I'd rather it went back through a friendly hand than a collecting one. Carry it to the parlor, quiet as you came by it, and we'll talk about faces.

agreed_persuaded.speaker: Cups
agreed_persuaded.text: ...Every hat, hm. You know what nobody's ever offered the tea-girl before? Standing. ...Done. Pour it in ink, I'll sign. But one cup won't drown a man like Coyle — you want Hellam's grudge on paper next to mine. Come back and say 'pour for three' and I'll have him here, wedding manners and all.

options.text: Pour for three, then. Set it up.

agreed_paid.speaker: Cups
agreed_paid.text: Ten. Well. The water's warmer already — funny how that works; it's why I sell the cups and not the kettle. Done, I'll sign. But one cup won't drown a man like Coyle — you want Hellam's grudge on paper next to mine. Come back and say 'pour for three' and I'll have him here, wedding manners and all.

options.text: Pour for three, then. Set it up.

arranged.speaker: Cups
arranged.text: Done and DONE. Hellam didn't even finish his cup — signed, sanded, sealed, then asked could he sign twice. Take the papers wherever names like Coyle's go to be spent. And friend — best rumor I ever poured, this one. Because I'm in it.

just_tea.speaker: Cups
just_tea.text: Free tea, paid company. Worst trade I make all day, and I make it happily — furniture gets lonely. That's me. I'm the furniture.
